# ADR-045 — The local-noon recurrence anchor is implementation metadata and must never reach presentation

**Status:** Locked

<!-- Decision text below is verbatim from the pre-split docs/DECISIONS.md table row (2026-09-16). Do not edit a Locked decision without explicit owner approval. -->

**The local-noon recurrence anchor is implementation metadata and must never reach presentation.** ADR-042 anchors a recurring all-day series' DTSTART at local noon for DST safety; ADR-045 states the consequence: `all_day === true` means date-only everywhere outside recurrence internals — never format, position, or narrate `occurs_at` for an all-day item. Presentation code uses the instance's `start_date`/`end_date`, which `assembleEventRange` already re-points per instance. `BriefEventItem` carries `date` and its `starts_at` is always null when `all_day` is true, so a time is *inexpressible* rather than merely discouraged; the Brief system prompt states the rule explicitly as defense in depth; and the decision lives in one shared helper (`apps/mobile/src/utils/event-time-label.ts`) used by both Today and Agenda so the chains cannot drift. Google/CalDAV semantics are explicitly out of scope — sync reads `events` rows directly and has zero references to the presentation projections (Checkpoint 5.7.1, 2026-08-24)
